product_title: Floral Shubh Labh Pearl Door Hangings
product_description: Welcome prosperity and positivity with this elegant handcrafted pair of Shubh Labh door hangings. Featuring vibrant pink roses, intricate golden latticework, pearl detailing, and auspicious Shubh Labh motifs, they add a traditional touch to your entrance, pooja room, or festive décor.
product_care_suggestion: Gently dust with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water, moisture, and direct sunlight.
Handle the floral embellishments and pearl tassels gently.
Store in a dry place in protective packaging when not in use.
